key_risks: Congressional buys are dated February 2026 with lags of 11 to 38 days; the price today is not the price they paid.

No committee alignment fired and no disclosed option positions, so there is no leveraged-conviction or oversight-adjacency leg.
Amount bands for congressional filings are ranges; the 100,001-250,000 Cisneros entry could sit anywhere in that band.
picks.invalidation: The August insider cohort stops buying or turns to sales in subsequent Form 4s, or the disclosed congressional buyers file sales, while price breaks below the 90-day low of 374.67.
